changes: Rounded page shortcuts stay side by side in a single swipeable row.
The shortcut scrollbar is hidden, including on mobile.

history.title: Shortcut button styling
changes: Restored the original rounded shortcut buttons at the top of each page.
Mobile shortcuts fit within the page and wrap when needed, without a scrolling strip or scrollbar.

history.title: Simpler player lists
changes: Top shortcuts stay in one horizontally scrolling row instead of stacking.
Expandable sections use simple disclosure arrows, and select menus use their normal browser controls.
Roster and matchup lists use compact aligned rows with subtle dividers instead of separate player boxes.
